text:
julia: hey @anna, hitting intermittent 400s from /v1/rerank in our Android app since last deploy. Error from server: \"400 Bad Request - invalid JSON\". attaching snippets from the client logs below.

anna: thanks julia — can you paste the full request headers + raw body (or the curl that reproduces it)? also include one `error_id` from the server logs if you have it.

julia: error_id=err_2026_9f2c. client log shows request headers:```
POST /v1/rerank HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.example
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Encoding: gzip
User-Agent: our-android-sdk/2.1.3
```
and the bytes after decompressing on-device look like this (weird):```
00 7b 22 69 74 65 6d 73 22 3a 5b 7b 22 74 65 78 74 22 3a 22 ...
```
which is `\x00{\"items\":[{\"text\":\"...\"}]}` — leading null byte before the JSON object. server returns 400. happening ~1.5% of requests, only from Android behind our mobile proxy.

ben: I can reproduce. if you send a gzip payload that starts with a null byte the API JSON parser returns 400. reproduced with this quick curl:```
printf "\\x00{\"items\":[{\"text\":\"hi\"}]}" | gzip | \
  curl -sS -X POST \"https://api.redwood.example/v1/rerank\" \
    -H \"Content-Encoding: gzip\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" --data-binary @- -D - -o /dev/null
```
response: HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{\"error\":\"invalid JSON\"}
```

mike: thanks for the repro ben. @anna @julia this looks like the edge/proxy is occasionally pre-pending a null byte when dealing with chunked+gzip bodies from the Android SDK. two potential vectors: (a) proxy double-decompress bug, or (b) SDK sending a stray null when streaming. can you grab the api-gateway logs for the request id err_2026_9f2c and the upstream proxy logs (X-Forwarded-For + request-id)?

api-gateway-bot: attached logs for err_2026_9f2c: upstream returned 400, upstream_body (truncated): "\u0000{\"items\":[{\"text\":\"...\"}]}". route: /v1/rerank, client_ip: 34.87.12.99.

mike: confirmed — gateway shows the leading null arriving at the parser. short-term mitigation: add tolerant parsing that strips up to one leading null/
whitespace byte before attempting JSON parse for the rerank endpoint and return a 422 if still invalid. longer-term: patch the proxy to stop injecting the null and push an SDK fix to avoid chunk preface.

anna: next steps for support: 1) send customer a workaround to set `Content-Encoding: identity` in the SDK (disable gzip) or upgrade to our patched SDK v2.1.5 when available; 2) collect a small sample of failing request ids and times so eng can correlate proxy logs; 3) mark this as P2 and notify infra.

julia: thanks — switched client to disable gzip for now and error rate dropped to ~0.02%. please keep me posted on the SDK patch timeline. :thumbsup:

ben: filing quick QA regression test: create integration that sends leading-null+gzip and ensure we return 400 currently but after mitigation we accept after stripping.

mike: assigning to eng-runtime to fix proxy behaviour and to SDK team for a patch. ETA for hotfix: 48h. will post incident update here when rolled.

julia: appreciated, will monitor.
